summary: uri options: seuser, src file to upload (not with body), status_code list of acceptable codes, timeout, unix_socket, and unredirected_headers.
questions: How do I accept 201 or 202 as success in uri?
How do I upload a file's content as the request body?
How do I call the Docker API over a unix socket?
How do I raise the uri timeout?

answer_card.title: uri status_code, src, timeout
answer_card.answer_md:
- `status_code` (`[200]`): acceptable codes, e.g. `[200, 201, 202]`
- `src`: file to send as body (not with `body`; pair with `force_basic_auth`)
- `timeout` (30s)
- `unix_socket`: e.g. `/var/run/docker.sock`
- `unredirected_headers`: e.g. `Authorization`
